dedupe_keys.name: referentiel national des batiments rnb france s national building identifier register

description: The RNB is a French public digital service that lists every building in the country and gives each one a unique identifier, so that administrations, local authorities and private bodies can follow buildings over time and join their data. Buildings come mainly from merging the national building database BDNB, published by CSTB, with IGN's BD TOPO, and the register is kept up to date through new editions of both, local building permit flows, community reports and other administrative processes. Users are asked to publish datasets enriched with RNB identifiers under an rnb tag on data.gouv.fr. Coverage: all of France. Access: free exports per department and a national export on data.gouv.fr, updated weekly (111 files when read), plus an API and a map. Licence: Licence Ouverte 2.0. Caveats: an identifier register, so building attributes stay in the source databases; identifiers can split or merge as buildings change. Simulation uses are a join key between building energy, permit, hazard and facility datasets in French exposure models and building stock twins. Related records: BDNB, BD TOPO and the ADEME energy performance diagnostics.
